title: Down These Strange Streets
author: George R. R. Martin and Gardner Dozois (editors)
note: conf=0.92; Urban fantasy/mystery anthology edited by George R. R. Martin and Gardner Dozois, published by Ace Books on October 4, 2011 (ISBN 0441020747). It is a standalone, unnumbered anthology — not part of a numbered series. It belongs only to the loose, unnumbered set of Martin/Dozois co-edited anthologies (Warriors, Songs of Love and Death, Dangerous Women, Rogues, Old Mars, Old Venus), which no source numbers as a sequence. Individual stories inside belong to authors' own series (e.g., Sookie Stackhouse universe, Nightside, Lord John Grey), but the book itself does not.
